name: Fukunaga Makoto
source:
A math teacher who acts also as a discipline advisor. Fukunaga Makoto has a strict approach both for herself and others. She suffers from mysophobia, hates when anything is dirty and untidy. In addition, Fukunaga's spartan attitude may come from learning karate. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20180603050830fw_/http://assemblage.co.jp/asm/software/12tchr/t09_mako.htm]official website (NSFW 18+)[/url].]
